blocks.text: Visual design platform that gives everyone creative superpowers

Canva democratized design by making it possible for anyone - not just designers - to create professional-looking visual content. With thousands of templates, millions of stock assets, and an intuitive drag-and-drop editor, the barrier to producing quality marketing materials dropped to near zero.

For startup marketing teams, Canva eliminates the bottleneck of waiting for a designer to create social media posts, presentations, or email headers. Anyone on the team can produce on-brand content using templates locked to your brand colors, fonts, and logos through the Brand Kit feature.

The AI features have elevated Canva beyond simple template editing. Magic Write generates copy, Magic Eraser removes objects from photos, text-to-image creates custom illustrations, and Magic Design generates complete layouts from a brief description. Each feature saves minutes that compound into hours across a team.
Millions of templates for social media, presentations, and print
Lock brand colors, fonts, logos, and guidelines for consistent output
AI writing, image generation, background removal, and design generation
Create and edit videos with templates, stock footage, and animations
Real-time editing, comments, approvals, and shared brand assets
Export for digital, print, and even order physical prints directly

Canva is the great equalizer for marketing teams without dedicated designers. The Brand Kit feature ensures consistency, and the AI tools accelerate production - letting small teams produce content volumes that used to require agencies.
Our team can integrate Canva into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
